title: Satisfy x Adidas *drops* Oct 30
hook: A $600 Pro Evo 2 one-off and a $160 Adios trainer.

slides.label: What dropped
slides.h: Satisfy and Adidas reveal a *new collab*
slides.c: A silver Pro Evo 2 one-off and two Adizero Adios colourways. Sold via Satisfy and Adidas from 30 Oct.

slides.label: Key details
slides.c: The Adizero Adios Satisfy trainer is $160 and goes on sale 30 Oct, 10 a.m. (US, reported).

slides.label: Why it's hyped
slides.c: Pro Evo 2 is Adidas' flagship racer, here in silver with Continental rubber. Reported as a one-off.

facts.claim: Satisfy x Adidas collection releases Oct 30; silver Pro Evo 2 plus two Adizero Adios styles
Pro Evo 2 Satisfy $600, Adizero Adios Satisfy $160; Oct 30 release
Adios Satisfy $160, on sale Oct 30 10 a.m.; Pro Evo 2 one-off $600
Pro Evo 2 Satisfy listed Coming Soon, 30 Oct, EUR 599

caption:
NEWS: Satisfy x Adidas drops on 30 Oct

As of 24 Oct, Satisfy and Adidas are releasing a silver Adizero Adios Pro Evo 2 one-off ($600 reported) and an Adizero Adios trainer ($160) on 30 Oct, with the trainer on sale at 10 a.m. US time.

Source: Complex, SNKRTODAY
